name: Sanguine Sorcery
summary: A librarian seeks magical works for the library. Your contribution adds to its collection and knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The librarian has asked you to bring something new for the shelves. Your contribution helps expand the library's knowledge.

faq.answer: The librarian asks you to bring something to add to the collection.
It comes from the librarian Garion Wendell in Stormwind, or from Owen Thadd in Undercity if you are Horde.

faq.q: Why bring magical works to the library?
faq.answer: The librarian says magical works may benefit the library and expand its knowledge.
